items.name: EU Consumer Rights Directive (distance selling)
items.scope: Pre-contract information, 14-day withdrawal right, and refund timelines for online/distance sales to consumers.
items.notes: Applies to B2C sales into the EU; national transposition varies.

items.name: PCI DSS
items.scope: Secure handling/transmission of cardholder data during checkout and payment capture.
items.notes: Typically satisfied by delegating card capture to a PCI-compliant payment gateway.

items.name: GDPR
items.scope: Lawful basis, minimization, and subject rights for customer account and order data.

items.name: VAT / Sales Tax
items.jurisdiction: varies — EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC for the EU; state/local sales tax in the US; no single global rule
items.scope: Tax must be calculated, collected, and remitted per the customer's and/or seller's jurisdiction; rates and thresholds (e.g. distance-selling registration thresholds) differ by country.
items.notes: No specific country's rate or threshold is asserted here; a deployment must configure its own tax engine/rules per jurisdiction.

provenance.notes: EU VAT Directive citation covers the EU case only; non-EU tax regimes are not sourced here and must be confirmed separately.
